mLocKeys.keySummary: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing damage and rooting enemies they come across. If cast near a seed, Grasping Roots grows a Vine Lasher, whose short range attacks reduce enemy Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for @RootDuration@ second(s) and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by @SlowAmountPlantAttack@% for @SlowDurationPlantAttack@ seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to @MaxSlowStacks@ times.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Vine Lasher</titleLeft><mainText>Vine Lashers are grown from Zyra's Seeds by her Grasping Roots spell. They engage her enemies with a slowing whip attack.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vine Lashers are grown from Zyra's Seeds by her Grasping Roots spell. They engage her enemies with a slowing whip attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Vine Lashers are grown from Zyra's Seeds by her Grasping Roots spell. They engage her enemies with a slowing whip attack.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every @SeedCooldown@ seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal @PlantDamage@ magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every @SeedCooldown@ seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal @PlantDamage@ magic damage.

Zyra's plants deal @MonsterMod@ bonus magic damage to monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Enrage</titleLeft><mainText>This plant is enraged, gaining increased Health and attacking in a flurry for 200% total damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. If cast near a seed, Deadly Spines grows a Thorn Spitter plant, which fires at enemies from afar.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing @InitialDamage@ magic damage.

If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Thorn Spitter</titleLeft><mainText>Thorn Spitters are grown from Zyra's seeds by her Deadly Spines spell. They shoot little `friendliness pellets` at her enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Thorn Spitters are grown from Zyra's seeds by her Deadly Spines spell. They shoot little `friendliness pellets` at her enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Thorn Spitters are grown from Zyra's seeds by her Deadly Spines spell. They shoot little `friendliness pellets` at her enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. Plants within the thicket are enraged.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for @KnockupDuration@ second.

Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining @EnragedBonusHealthPercent*100@% Health and Attacking for @PlantDamageBonus@% bonus damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Knocked Airborne</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been knocked upward by the snapping of Zyra's stranglethorns.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Seed Vision</titleLeft><mainText>Zyra's team can see this champion because it stepped on a large seed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds. Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots cast near seeds will turn them into plants who fight for Zyra. Zyra can store multiple seeds at once, and killing enemies reduces Rampant Growth's recharge time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zyra plants a Seed that lasts @SeedDuration@ seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for @VisionGranted@ seconds, but are still destroyed.

This Ability has 2 charges with a @AmmoRechargeTime@ second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by @KillAmmoRefundMinion*100@%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by @KillAmmoRefundChamp*100@% instead.
